parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host instance ID

堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID。

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html

parameters.help_en: The name of the audit policy. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with a special character and can contain only the following special characters: periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), backslashes (), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 审计规则名称。长度为1-128个字符，不能以特殊字符开头，只可包含特殊字符中的'.'、'_'、'-'、'\'以及空格

parameters.help_en: The description of the audit policy. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 审计规则备注。最多500个字符

The type of the auditable asset scope rule. Valid values:

1: all projects.

2: specified projects

指定可审计的资产范围规则类型。取值：

1：所有项目。

2：指定项目
parameters.name: scope_type
